name: zVram
tagline: Experimental Vulkan memory expansion with a standalone NX manager

artifacts.label: Vulkan launcher and manager (Linux x86_64)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Requires Python 3, Tk, libzstd and a working Vulkan driver. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH for Steam and terminal use. Reopen the manager after updates. Profiles, logs and model files are preserved. Model serving additionally needs Vulkan llama-server on PATH or an explicit --server path. This package contains the Vulkan backend; experimental HIP remains a source-build option.
